Definition: middle voice from G1909 and G2564; to entitle; by implication, to invoke (for aid, worship, testimony, decision, etc.):--appeal (unto), call (on, upon), surname.
BiblicalUsage: Epikaleomai means to call upon, to invoke — to call on the name of the Lord. Whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved; and Paul is sent to open eyes, that men may call on Him in whom they have believed.
TheologicalSignificance: Calling on His name is the simplest and greatest act of faith, I believe: a cry for help that God has promised to answer.
